summary: Iteration 16 - Frontend E2E verification of NEW profit sharing / settlement module (Superadmin, Admin, Lender, Borrower views). Tested via preview URL with temp Superadmin 081900000777. Reset passwords via /api/users/{id}/reset-password for 1 TEST admin + 1 TEST lender + 1 TEST borrower and completed force-password flow via UI. VERIFIED: (1) Superadmin sidebar menu 'Bagi Hasil' (in LAINNYA section) opens /profit-sharing with 4 tabs (share-tab-dashboard/settlement/payout/history) all rendering; Dashboard shows all 11 stat cards including stat-profit-pool Rp2.440.000 (7 lunas), stat-interest Rp2.240.000, stat-latefee Rp200.000, stat-lender-share Rp1.464.000 (60%), stat-admin-share Rp610.000 (25%), stat-platform-share Rp366.000 (15%), stat-admin-earned Rp610.000, stat-admin-payable Rp0, stat-admin-paid Rp250.000, stat-platform-collected Rp150.000 (earned Rp366.000). Rumus konsisten: 1.464.000 + 610.000 + 366.000 = 2.440.000 ✓. (2) Settings > tab 'Bagi Hasil' (settings-tab-profit): fields ps-lender/admin/platform-input + ps-total indicator + save-profit-sharing-btn all present. Enter 60/25/14 -> ps-total shows 'Total: 99% -- harus tepat 100%' (destructive color) AND save-profit-sharing-btn is DISABLED ✓. Enter 60/25/15 -> ps-total shows 'Total: 100% (valid)' AND save button ENABLED ✓, save succeeds. (3) Rekening Settlement Pusat card (sa-type/number/holder/bank/instructions-input + save-settlement-account-btn) persists BCA/1234567890/PT DANA TALANG and shows correctly on Lender's /settlement page (settlement-account-card visible with same values). (4) Loan Detail PIN-20260818-0038 (PAID with distribution) shows section loan-profit-share + loan-share-breakdown with correct math: Pokok Rp2.000.000 + Bunga Rp200.000 + Denda Rp0 = Total Diterima Rp2.200.000; Profit Pool Rp200.000 split Pendana60%=Rp120.000 + Admin25%=Rp50.000 + Aplikator15%=Rp30.000; Hak Pokok Pendana Rp2.000.000 + profit Rp120.000 = Total Hak Pendana Rp2.120.000; Wajib Disetor Rp80.000. Identity holds: (Total Hak + Wajib Disetor) = 2.120.000+80.000 = 2.200.000 = Total Diterima ✓ dan lender_profit+admin_profit+platform_profit = 120k+50k+30k = 200k = profit_pool ✓. Badge share-badge-PENDING (settlement) visible. (5) Legacy loan PIN-20260816-0001 (PAID but pre-snapshot) shows loan-profit-share-legacy message correctly (no breakdown) ✓. (6) Borrower login: loan-profit-share section is HIDDEN on their loan detail ✓; /profit-sharing, /settlement, /earnings all redirect to /dashboard ✓. (7) Admin login (TEST Admin Satu): /earnings renders with stat-admin-earned Rp50.000 (1 pinjaman lunas) + stat-admin-payable Rp0 ('Setoran Pendana sudah diterima') + stat-admin-paid Rp0, admin-earnings-summary + admin-earnings-list + earning-card-<id> visible showing correct 25% share of PIN-20260818-0038. Admin has ZERO verify-settlement/mark-payout/reject-settlement buttons ✓. Admin visiting /profit-sharing redirects to /earnings ✓. Sidebar shows 'Penghasilan' link. (8) Lender login (TEST Lender B): /settlement renders lender-share-summary + settlement-tab-open + settlement-tab-done + settlement-account-card. This lender has no settlements pending so lender-settlement-list is empty (settle-btn count=0) -- validated markup exists but couldn't exercise settlement-dialog / settlement-amount-readonly / settlement-file-input / settlement-submit-btn on live data (backend pytest confirmed these). (9) Settlement Pendana tab (Superadmin) shows existing distributions with full breakdown (Pokok/Bunga/Denda/Total Diterima/Profit Pool/60-25-15/Total Hak Pendana/Wajib Disetor); reject-settlement-dialog / verify-settlement-btn / reject-settlement-reason / reject-settlement-submit selectors present in DOM code — but no items in 'Menunggu Verifikasi' section right now (all seeded distributions are PENDING or SETTLED), so I could not physically click reject/verify on live data. Same for payout-dialog + payout-amount-readonly (all admin_payout_status are NOT_READY or PAID, none PENDING). (10) Mobile 390x844: Superadmin /profit-sharing dashboard + settlement tab and Lender /settlement all render without layout overflow — tabs stack, cards fill width, bottom-nav 'Bagi Hasil' + top summary card readable. (11) approve-superadmin-dialog + assigned-admin-select + approve-with-admin-btn present in LoanDetail.jsx code but NOT triggered live because there are ZERO WAITING_ADMIN_APPROVAL loans in current DB state. Backend pytest (test_iter16_profit_sharing 16/16) already covers approval-with-admin RBAC.

minor.issue: Returns 500 (TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable at loan_service.borrower_credit) when the loan's borrower has been deleted from users collection while loan doc still exists. Reproduce: GET /api/loans/6555e629-e5e1-4b34-b304-144bf4b552ad. Only affects orphaned DB state (test leftovers); production borrowers should not normally be deleted. Fix: guard `if borrower is None: return None` in loan_routes.get_loan before calling LS.borrower_credit.

action_items: Optional cleanup: many test leftover users/loans/distributions from previous iterations still exist in the shared DB (7 orphaned PAID loans without borrower doc, 3 TEST admins, 2 TEST lenders, 1 TEST borrower). Not blocking; but the GET /api/loans/{id} 500 above is triggered when superadmin opens any of those orphans in UI. Recommend adding the None-guard on the backend AND running a cleanup script.

Minor sidebar test-id inconsistency: Admin sidebar item 'Penghasilan' -- [data-testid=desknav-penghasilan] returned count=0 in my probe (label may be lowercased with trimmed spaces; the code does `bottomnav-${label.toLowerCase()}` which gives 'penghasilan' — but the mobile bottom-nav check via bottomnav-* was not exercised for admin). Not blocking; sidebar link works visually.

Neither UI E2E nor this run exercised the reject-settlement dialog, payout dialog, approve-with-admin dialog live, because current preview DB has no matching seed. Recommend main agent seeds 1 loan in each state (WAITING_ADMIN_APPROVAL, distribution WAITING_VERIFICATION, distribution admin_payout PENDING) so future testing agents can click through those dialogs; backend pytest already covers them.
critical_code_review_comments: profit.jsx ShareBreakdown component renders identity (Total Hak Pendana + Wajib Disetor = Total Diterima) as separate rows without a runtime assertion — good for display, but a small unit test in frontend could catch rounding regressions.
Settings.jsx correctly disables save-profit-sharing-btn when total != 100 (psTotal !== 100) and shows destructive-colored error text — matches spec exactly.
LoanDetail.jsx approve flow: superadmin uses a nested Dialog (approve-superadmin-dialog) with the assigned-admin-select mandatory (Setujui button disabled while adminId is empty) — correct.
Layout.jsx nav builds testid via `${label.toLowerCase()}` which produces 'bagi hasil' with a space — works but is fragile; prefer a slug like 'bagi-hasil'.
backend/loan_routes.py:172 does not null-check `borrower` before calling LS.borrower_credit(borrower) — see minor issue above.
